name: Exp_BullsBearsEyes
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBullsBearsEyes custom indicator, which is a smoothed Bulls/Bears oscillator. It generates buy and sell signals depending on the selected algorithm mode (trend direction change, midline breakdown, or overbought/oversold level breakthroughs), and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBullsBearsEyes自定义指标进行交易，该指标是平滑后的多空力量振荡器。根据所选算法模式（趋势方向变化、中线突破或超买超卖水平突破）生成买卖信号，并使用可配置的止损和止盈管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于BullsBearsEyes振荡器，这是一个经过gamma平滑处理的多空力量指标，用于衡量市场买卖压力的相对强度。入场条件根据四种算法模式确定：twist模式检测趋势方向变化，breakdown1模式检测中线突破，breakdown2模式检测超买超卖水平突破，breakdown3模式结合超买超卖区域退出和水平突破。当指标缓冲区2的值为+2时开多仓，为-2时开空仓，正值时平空仓，负值时平多仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算仓位大小。资金管理使用固定止损（默认1000点）和止盈（默认2000点），止损大于止盈暗示盈亏比不佳但胜率可能较高。出场条件除了止损止盈外，还包括反向信号平仓机制，允许独立控制买卖方向的开启和关闭权限。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the BullsBearsEyes oscillator, a gamma-smoothed bulls/bears power indicator that measures the relative strength of buying and selling pressure in the market. Entry conditions are determined by four algorithm modes: twist mode detects trend direction changes, breakdown1 detects midline crossovers, breakdown2 detects overbought/oversold level breakthroughs, and breakdown3 combines overbought/oversold zone exits with level breakthroughs. A buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 2 reads +2, a sell signal at -2, while positive values trigger short position closing and negative values trigger long position closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based sizing. Money management employs fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), with the stop loss being larger than take profit, suggesting a higher win-rate but unfavorable risk-reward ratio approach. Exit conditions include stop loss/take profit as well as reverse signal closing, with independent permission controls for buy/sell opening and closing directions.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lots; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Maximum price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供四种算法模式灵活切换，适应不同市场环境
买卖方向的开启和关闭权限可独立控制，便于策略优化和单向交易
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
依赖自定义指标句柄进行信号判断，逻辑清晰且模块化程度高
支持按存款比例动态计算仓位，便于资金管理
pros_en: Offers four algorithm modes for flexible switching to adapt to different market conditions
Independent permission controls for buy/sell opening and closing enable strategy optimization and directional trading
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Signal logic relies on custom indicator handles with clear and modular architecture
Supports deposit share-based dynamic position sizing for better money management
cons: 止损(1000点)小于止盈(2000点)的风险回报比不合理，实际应为1:2但这里SL<TP暗示反向思维，需仔细验证
缺少点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在高点差时段产生不利入场
没有追踪止损或移动止损功能，无法锁定浮动利润
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库文件，增加了部署和调试复杂度
SignalBar=1使用已完成K线但未对指标计算失败做充分错误处理
cons_en: The stop loss (1000 points) vs take profit (2000 points) relationship needs careful verification as the risk-reward ratio may be unfavorable depending on interpretation
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially entering during high-spread periods
No trailing stop or moving stop feature to lock in floating profits
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, increasing deployment and debugging complexity
SignalBar=1 uses completed bars but error handling for indicator calculation failures is insufficient
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，避免在高点差时段入场，提高成交质量
添加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时逐步锁定利润，优化出场策略
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to avoid entering during high-spread periods and improve execution quality
Implement a trailing stop feature to progressively lock in profits during trend continuation and optimize exit strategy

risk_points: 止损和止盈比例需确认，若SL>TP则存在单笔亏损大于盈利的风险
缺少点差过滤可能在流动性差时段产生滑点较大的成交
MM参数负值直接指定手数时无最小手数校验，可能导致过小或过大仓位
risk_points_en: Stop loss to take profit ratio needs confirmation; if SL>TP, single loss could exceed single gain
Lack of spread filter may cause unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods with high slippage
MM parameter with negative values directly specifying lot size lacks minimum lot validation, potentially causing oversized or undersized positions
